Duramin-40
Automatic micro/macro hardness tester
Versatile hardness testing that ensures Suitable for Vickers, Knoop and
repeatability over a wide load range Brinell hardness testing
Duramin-40 is the primary range of Struers micro/macro Automatic 6-position turret
hardness testers. It is available with a manual and Manual and motorised XY-stage
motorised XY-stage and with an overview camera. Motorised Z-axis
Duramin-40 comes with three load ranges; 10 gf - 10 kgf, Anti-collision system
10 gf - 31.25 kgf, and 1 gf - 62.5 kgf. The tester includes Automatic illumination
an integrated PC with a separate monitor for touch screen Overview camera option
or mouse operation. Duel monitors are also an option. The Report editor
test cycle is fully automatic and a motorised 6-position Embedded PC with mouse or touch screen operation
turret is standard. Add-on modules include Kc fracture
measurements, mapping and weld measurements.
